name: Slack
description: Send and receive Slack messages. Triggers only on @alto mentions.

trigger.description: A Slack message that mentions Alto.

functions.name: slack_send_message
functions.description: Send a message to a Slack channel or user.

channel_id.description: The Slack channel ID or user ID to send the message to.

thread_ts.description: Optional timestamp to send message in thread.

functions.name: slack_add_reaction
functions.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message.

channel_id.description: The Slack channel ID containing the message.

timestamp.description: The message timestamp to react to.

emoji.description: The emoji name to add (without colons).

settings_schema.label: Bot Token
settings_schema.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Set in server .env file.

settings_schema.label: Workspace ID
settings_schema.description: Slack workspace ID (T...). Set in server .env file.

settings_schema.label: App-Level Token
settings_schema.description: Slack app-level token (xapp-...) for Socket Mode. Set in server .env file.

settings_schema.label: Allowed Channels
settings_schema.description: Slack channel IDs where Alto is allowed to operate.

settings_schema.label: Allowed Users
settings_schema.description: Slack user IDs that can trigger Alto.

settings_schema.label: Thread Replies
settings_schema.description: Allow Alto to reply in threads.

settings_schema.label: Emoji Reactions
settings_schema.description: Allow Alto to add emoji reactions.
